people.name: Mattan
people.line: Priest of Baal, killed during Jehoiada's reforms.

translations.web: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
translations.bsb: So all the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translations.kjv: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake ➔ his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
translations.asv: And all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
